So we cannot use the function directly because it doesn't support searching for yoga retreats or vegetarian meals or spa services. There's no function that matches exactly. We could try to interpret "spa services" as "Fitness Centre"? No, that's not correct. Also "Breakfast" might cover vegetarian meals? Not necessarily. The function only supports "Breakfast", "Fitness Centre", "Free Wi-Fi", "Parking". None match "Yoga Retreat" or "Vegetarian Meals" or "Spa Services".

Thus we cannot use the function. We should respond that we can't find such a place using the available function. According to policy, we should say we can't do that.
